_comment: Repairs for the networks' fragile values, read by every install once a day and applied over what each release ships (docs/specs/published-repairs.md). Only keys a build knows are used, and only values that fit their kind: request and app ids, versions, client ids, user agents. Nothing here can change where a request goes. Each entry must be the value this repository ships (a unit test checks it): to repair a network, change the value here and in lib/plugins/plugin_repairs.dart together.
